title: Analysis code: agent-specific opioid response, nurse-led pain reassessment and prediction of non-response in postoperative intensive care
description: Python analysis code for the article "Beyond Dose Escalation: Agent-Specific Opioid Response, Nurse-Led Pain Reassessment and Prediction of Non-Response in Postoperative Intensive Care". The scripts build dose-level and episode-level analytic files from MIMIC-IV v3.1 and eICU-CRD v2.0 (credentialed access via PhysioNet) and reproduce the within-patient dose-response, hospital variation and prediction analyses. No patient-level data are included.
